name: Wilhelm Wundt
shortBio: Founding father of modern experimental psychology; established the first formal psychological research laboratory at Leipzig in 1879.
centralQuestion: How can the immediate contents of conscious experience and psychological apperception be systematically analyzed and measured?

keyWorks.title: Principles of Physiological Psychology
keyWorks.description: Seminal textbook establishing psychology as an independent laboratory discipline.

keyWorks.title: Outlines of Psychology
keyWorks.description: Systematic overview of psychical processes, apperception, and voluntarism.
